title: Honey Pecan Granola
changes_from_base: Pressed into a firm, even sheet with a metal spatula and baked unstirred so it sets into big chunks, using oil, maple syrup and a generous amount of honey and cinnamon, with pecans in the bake and chopped raisins added once cool.
summary: A honey-touched granola studded with toasted pecans and sticky raisins, baked until crisp and shattering.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray (about 33 x 46 cm)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Line
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan) and position the shelf in the upper-middle; line a large rimmed baking tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk 120 ml vegetable oil, 80 ml maple syrup, 113 g runny honey, 4 tsp vanilla, 3 tsp ground cinnamon and ½ tsp fine salt.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Fold 425 g rolled oats and 225 g pecans roughly chopped into the whisked syrup until everything is evenly coated.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Tip onto the lined tray, spread thinly and press down very hard with a stiff metal spatula to create a compact, even sheet.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Place in the oven for 40-45 min, rotating the tray halfway, until pale golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Remove and leave to cool on a wire rack for 1 h, which helps it stay crisp.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Once cooled, break into pieces of whatever size you prefer and stir through 285 g raisins roughly chopped.

tips: Honey browns faster than maple syrup, so watch the edges near the end of baking and take the tray out as soon as they turn deep golden.
Press the mixture down very firmly before baking to achieve satisfying crispy clusters
Cool on a wire rack rather than the tray so air circulates underneath
Add raisins only after cooling completely so they don't soften further
storage: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
